strings.name: David Card
strings.summary: Card uses natural experiments to study minimum wages, immigration and education, testing economic accounts against real policy changes. Collaborating with Krueger, Ashenfelter and others, he advanced research design and causal analysis. A longtime Berkeley academic and later emeritus professor, he received half the 2021 economics prize; Angrist and Imbens shared the other half.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Used natural experiments to study minimum wages, immigration and education, advancing modern empirical labor economics.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f1.value: Born in 1956 in Guelph, Ontario, Canada.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: BA, Queen’s(1978); PhD in economics, Princeton(1983).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Natural experiments
strings.highlights.h1.text: Used wage policies, migration and education changes to investigate labor-market causality.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Minimum wages
strings.highlights.h2.text: With Alan Krueger, compared fast-food employment in New Jersey and Pennsylvania, advancing empirical debate.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Economics prize
strings.timeline.t1.text: Received half the 2021 prize for empirical labor-economics contributions.
strings.timeline.t2.title: AEA president
strings.timeline.t2.text: Served as the American Economic Association’s annual president.
strings.timeline.t3.title: IZA labor prize
strings.timeline.t3.text: Shared the award with Orley Ashenfelter.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Berkeley faculty
strings.timeline.t4.text: Moved from Princeton to the University of California, Berkeley.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Myth and Measurement
strings.timeline.t5.text: Co-authored the minimum-wage research book with Krueger.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Minimum-wage experiment
strings.timeline.t6.text: Published with Krueger a comparative study of New Jersey’s wage change and fast-food employment.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Mariel migration study
strings.timeline.t7.text: Used the Cuban Mariel boatlift to study Miami’s labor market.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Doctorate and early teaching
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed Princeton’s doctorate and joined its faculty after a brief Chicago appointment.
